#include <string>
#include <sstream>

    std::string input;
    std::getline(std::cin, input);
    std::string s;
    std::istringstream iss(input);
    iss >> s;

    int ans = 0;
    int cnt = 1;
    char prev = '#';

    for (char c : s) {
        if (c == prev) {
            cnt++;
        } else {
            if ((cnt & 1) == 0) {
                ans++;
            }
            cnt = 1;
        }
        prev = c;
    }
    if ((cnt & 1) == 0) {
        ans++;
    }
    std::cout << ans << std::endl;

    return 0;
}
